in_marathi.name: Jayabal
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Victory of God
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jayabal हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Jayabal is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Jaya' meaning victory and 'Bala' meaning God. It represents the victory of God over all obstacles and challenges in life.
